# Objective

# Data loading and split

```{r data}
load("whodata.RData")       # loads object who
load("whoRAWdata.RData")    # loads object whoRAW

stopifnot(exists("who"), exists("whoRAW"))
dim(who)
dim(whoRAW)
names(who)
sum(is.na(who))
sum(is.na(whoRAW))
identical(who$Year, whoRAW$Year)
identical(who$Status, whoRAW$Status)
```

```{r split}
set.seed(123)
n <- nrow(who)
train_idx <- sample(seq_len(n), size = floor(2/3 * n))

who_train <- who[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
who_test <- who[-train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
whoRAW_train <- whoRAW[train_idx, , drop = FALSE]
whoRAW_test <- whoRAW[-train_idx, , drop = FALSE]

dim(who_train)
dim(who_test)
dim(whoRAW_train)
dim(whoRAW_test)
```


# Ordinary linear regression

```{r ordinary-models}
model_who <- lm(Life.expectancy ~ ., data = who_train)
model_raw <- lm(Life.expectancy ~ ., data = whoRAW_train)
summary(model_who)
summary(model_raw)
```

## RMSE

```{r ordinary-rmse}
rmse <- function(actual, predicted) sqrt(mean((actual - predicted)^2))

pred_who_train <- predict(model_who, newdata = who_train)
pred_who_test  <- predict(model_who, newdata = who_test)
pred_raw_train <- predict(model_raw, newdata = whoRAW_train)
pred_raw_test  <- predict(model_raw, newdata = whoRAW_test)

rmse_results <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Preprocessed", "Preprocessed", "Raw", "Raw"),
  Split = c("Training", "Test", "Training", "Test"),
  RMSE = c(
    rmse(who_train$Life.expectancy, pred_who_train),
    rmse(who_test$Life.expectancy, pred_who_test),
    rmse(whoRAW_train$Life.expectancy, pred_raw_train),
    rmse(whoRAW_test$Life.expectancy, pred_raw_test)
  )
)
knitr::kable(rmse_results, digits = 4)
```

## Measured versus estimated values

```{r ordinary-prediction-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(who_train$Life.expectancy, pred_who_train,
     main = "Preprocessed - Training", xlab = "Measured Life Expectancy",
     ylab = "Estimated Life Expectancy", pch = 19)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
plot(who_test$Life.expectancy, pred_who_test,
     main = "Preprocessed - Test", xlab = "Measured Life Expectancy",
     ylab = "Estimated Life Expectancy", pch = 19)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
plot(whoRAW_train$Life.expectancy, pred_raw_train,
     main = "Raw - Training", xlab = "Measured Life Expectancy",
     ylab = "Estimated Life Expectancy", pch = 19)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
plot(whoRAW_test$Life.expectancy, pred_raw_test,
     main = "Raw - Test", xlab = "Measured Life Expectancy",
     ylab = "Estimated Life Expectancy", pch = 19)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

# Robust regression

```{r robust-models}
if (!requireNamespace("robustbase", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Install package 'robustbase' with install.packages('robustbase') before knitting.")
}
library(robustbase)

robust_who <- lmrob(Life.expectancy ~ ., data = who_train)

robust_control <- lmrob.control(max.it = 100, k.max = 500, maxit.scale = 500)
robust_raw_retry <- lmrob(
  Life.expectancy ~ ., data = whoRAW_train, control = robust_control
)

summary(robust_who)
summary(robust_raw_retry)
```



## Robust diagnostics

```{r robust-diagnostics, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(robust_who)
plot(robust_raw_retry)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```


# Robust prediction performance

```{r robust-predictions}
pred_robust_who_train <- predict(robust_who, newdata = who_train)
pred_robust_who_test  <- predict(robust_who, newdata = who_test)
pred_robust_raw_train <- predict(robust_raw_retry, newdata = whoRAW_train)
pred_robust_raw_test  <- predict(robust_raw_retry, newdata = whoRAW_test)

robust_rmse_results <- data.frame(
  Dataset = c("Preprocessed robust", "Preprocessed robust",
              "Raw robust retry", "Raw robust retry"),
  Split = c("Training", "Test", "Training", "Test"),
  RMSE = c(
    rmse(who_train$Life.expectancy, pred_robust_who_train),
    rmse(who_test$Life.expectancy, pred_robust_who_test),
    rmse(whoRAW_train$Life.expectancy, pred_robust_raw_train),
    rmse(whoRAW_test$Life.expectancy, pred_robust_raw_test)
  )
)
knitr::kable(robust_rmse_results, digits = 4)
```


```{r robust-prediction-plots, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(who_train$Life.expectancy, pred_robust_who_train,
     main = "Preprocessed Robust - Training",
     xlab = "Measured Life Expectancy", ylab = "Estimated Life Expectancy", pch = 19)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
plot(who_test$Life.expectancy, pred_robust_who_test,
     main = "Preprocessed Robust - Test",
     xlab = "Measured Life Expectancy", ylab = "Estimated Life Expectancy", pch = 19)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
plot(whoRAW_train$Life.expectancy, pred_robust_raw_train,
     main = "Raw Robust - Training",
     xlab = "Measured Life Expectancy", ylab = "Estimated Life Expectancy", pch = 19)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
plot(whoRAW_test$Life.expectancy, pred_robust_raw_test,
     main = "Raw Robust - Test",
     xlab = "Measured Life Expectancy", ylab = "Estimated Life Expectancy", pch = 19)
abline(0, 1, col = "red", lwd = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
